scope: All 123 current Echo records, each with both actual server-encoded prefixes and the full source MP3.

records.expectedText: Your fate was foreshadowed in the mist.
First blood spills. I demand more!
Mixed that up special for you!
Sharp as winter's teeth.
The stout heart knows no fear!
No one to blame but yourself.
You get nothing. Good day, sir!
I'll see you in your death-dream.
A message from on high: You're dead!
The dogs of war feast tonight!
The Flayed Ones drink your blood.
Where do you think you're going?
First blood! I'll drink to that.
Yeah, that chinned ya, didn't it?
First blood goes to mother!
My hooves run red with first blood.
I'll trample your bones to dust.
Only the penitent can be forgiven.
I give the gift of death.
First Blood, and it's already icing over!
The rules of battle dictate your demise.
What, you thought you would win?
First blood! They all break so easily.
My shadow shall darken all creation.
You brought me back again? Again?!
War is an equation, death the solution.
See you in the seven hells.
You fought and died with honor.
First blood, and a point well taken.
From death's soil, new life sprouts.
Don't take that magnitude with me.
Against me, all warfare is asymmetric.
First blood! In flames!
What an enchanting day for battle!
From void and shadow, I assemble.
I returned to fulfill my destiny!
I'll tear you limb from limb.
First blood! I create nothing from something!
What happened? Your legs not working?
First blood! And it's still pulsing.
I will learn from that death.
First blood was never yours to take.
We burned your candle at both ends.
One battle is hardly the war.
First blood! My quest begins auspiciously!
Death from ground level!
First blood, and here come the sharks.
Sick lyrics, bro. You're a real weirdo.
First blood stains the banners!
Your desolation and the world's are one.
From cold death, I rise again.
Unleashed once more upon the world.
First Blood! This one's gonna be a scorcher!
I've got the magic touch.
Is more of my power needed?
Lost in the woods, are you?
My claws bathe in your blood.
The power warms me from within.
It's an honorable death, by my hand!
First blood, and it came so easily.
Should do it again some time!
First blood! It was ours all along.
First Blood! Ha! I'm just getting started.
Didn't you see me waving?
Death doesn't rule this place, I do.
No school like the old school.
The stench of death is upon you.
A beautiful soul for my collection.
You expected daylight to protect you?
I hear your thoughts no more.
A mind prepared, a death foretold.
First Blood! You got some on you.
First blood! An offering to the Omniscience.
Consequences will never be the same.
First blood! It's as expected. Yes?
Death at my hands is an honor.
First blood! Let our great combat begin!
First Blood! It shall be duly noted.
Time for a choppin block party!
You were oblivious, now you're mine.
Death comes in at the ears.
I'll polish my armor in your blood.
First Blood, and the atmosphere's electric!
I'd've done that one for free.
Well done, everyone. I've got some notes.
No sorcery lies beyond my grasp.
You were expecting...Sandy Claws?
Your soul will make a fine minion!
In death, I learn life's mysteries!
Trees? Why did it have to be trees?
Once a warrior, now a fool.
First Blood! I've still got it!
Skree'auk's talons pierce your soul.
Now you dwell in the deep!
You wanted out of here, didn't you?
First blood! Say hello to my boomstick!
Now that's what I call stoppin' power.
From another dimension, a world beyond.
Didn't see me coming, did you?
Let's have the spotlight. Over here!
You should not have crossed me.
First blood! Start with a bang!
You never could keep a secret.
Let's bare your soul, shall we?
Blood in the water, time to feed!
And they said I was crazy!
First Blood! Better yours than mine.
A battle! Has that always been there?
You were a casualty of war.
You were out of your weightclass!
First blood! They sing the song of death!!
You and yours will not prevail.
Power like a promise of revenge!
First Blood is the sweetest.
First blood, with a poison twist.
To oppose me is to deny death.
Rest well. Your death has consequence.
Death has no command over me.
Shuttle and loom, I weave your doom.
Could I have killed you any deader?
You have tangled with an Eldwurm!
I'm known for my graveside manner.
God's gift to the world: Me.
